_comment: DESIGN.md §10.1. Empty. The weapon should reliably kill one or two current-wave monsters unaided, and regen must undo chip damage on a full lane clear - these two levers set the first elimination at roughly wave 13-15 (§5.5). All ranges must stay freely adjustable: whether the fortress fights or sits back is an open experiment.

auras._comment: One active at a time, player-chosen. Strength and radius upgrade separately (§10.1).

resourceBuilding._comment: §10.2. Adjacent to the fortress, cannot be attacked. Produces gems.
